snippet.title: Adventures Abound in Pokémon GO — A New Season is Here!
snippet.description:
New adventures await in Pokémon GO! Will you take on a City Safari? Or are the Pokémon of Paldea calling your name?

No matter where you are, new adventures, new memories, and new friends are always around the corner with Pokémon GO.
